pokemon.title: The Patient Grower
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, FRLG): naps in bright sunlight and grows at its own pace; anime: Ash's Bulbasaur refuses to evolve and keeps the peace at Oak's lab; Mystery Dungeon starter quiz: Calm/Docile.
pokemon.blurb: You grow on your own schedule and you don't apologise for it. People lean on you because you're steady: you'd rather settle an argument between two friends than start one, and you notice when someone is wilting before they say a word. You don't chase glory, but you'll stand your ground for a cause you believe in. Like Bulbasaur, you store up sunshine for the days that need it.

pokemon.title: The Flickering Flame
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, SV): the tail flame flares with feeling and burns weakly when it is unhappy; anime: waits on a rock in the rain for the trainer who abandoned it; Mystery Dungeon starter quiz: Brave/Timid mix.
pokemon.blurb: Your feelings run close to the surface: everyone can tell what kind of day you're having from across the room. You throw yourself at things with real heat, and when you commit to someone you stay long after they've stopped deserving it. A setback can dim you for a while, but it never puts you out. You're Charmander: small flame, enormous potential, impossible to ignore.

pokemon.title: The Proud Champion
pokemon.why: Pokedex (FRLG, SV): refuses to use its flames on anything weaker than itself and seeks out stronger foes; anime: Ash's Charizard ignores orders until it respects him; Mystery Dungeon: Brave.
pokemon.blurb: You'd rather lose to someone great than beat someone easy. Respect is your currency: you give it slowly and you expect it back, and when you decide someone has earned yours you become their most loyal weapon. Rules and routines bore you; a worthy opponent wakes you up. You're Charizard, and the people who stuck with you through the difficult phase know exactly what that was worth.

pokemon.title: The Squad Leader
pokemon.why: Anime: leader of the Squirtle Squad, sunglasses and all, who still chooses to come back to Ash; Pokedex (RBY): a playful Pokemon that shoots water at any target; Mystery Dungeon: Jolly/Naive.
pokemon.blurb: You've got a crew, and you're the one in the sunglasses at the front of it. You make mischief look like leadership, and your friends follow because being around you is simply more fun. Underneath the swagger is a solid sense of right and wrong: when the joke is over you show up and do the work. You're Squirtle, cool on the outside, dependable all the way down.

pokemon.title: The Gentle Wanderer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, SV): searches for the sweetest honey and the flowers that hold it; anime: Ash's first full evolution and the first goodbye, flying off with its mate; nothing combative anywhere on record.
pokemon.blurb: You go where the sweetness is. Competition means little to you; connection means everything, and you'd quietly fly off to be with the people you love over any prize. You're easily moved and you don't hide it, which makes you the friend people call when they need to be understood. You're Butterfree: light, loyal, and braver than you look when it counts.

pokemon.title: The Loyal Spark
pokemon.why: Anime: refuses the Poke Ball but never leaves Ash's side across every series; Pokedex (Yellow, Sw): sparks fly from its cheeks when it is excited or angry, and it is curious enough to zap whatever it finds; Mystery Dungeon: Hardy/Jolly.
pokemon.blurb: You run on enthusiasm and you share it freely: the room is louder and warmer once you're in it. You pick your people and then you're theirs, through every bad decision and every long road. You like winning, but mostly you like winning next to someone. You're Pikachu: the partner everyone wishes they had, and the one who won't be put in a box.

pokemon.title: The Moonlight Dancer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): dances under the full moon and is said to have come from the Moon; shy around people but adorably playful; anime: Clefairy build a rocket ship and hold moonlight rituals.
pokemon.blurb: You're a little bit from somewhere else and you like it that way. Your imagination runs wild, your heart is soft, and you find rituals and wonder in things other people walk straight past. You'd rather dance in a circle of friends at midnight than fight anyone for anything. You're Clefairy: whimsical, warm, and quietly mysterious.

pokemon.title: The Night Fairy
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): so timid that it flees at the slightest sound, lives on quiet mountains and dances under the moon; said to hear a pin drop a mile away.
pokemon.blurb: You hear everything and you'd rather not be heard. You're gentle and dreamy, private by instinct, and happiest somewhere quiet with the moon out. You don't compete and you don't crowd. You're Clefable: soft, secretive, and a little bit celestial.

pokemon.title: The Thousand-Year Grudge
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): lives a thousand years, understands human speech, and curses anyone who grabs its tails; anime: calm, elegant, and devoted to one master for centuries.
pokemon.blurb: You are patient in a way that unsettles people. You remember everything, forgive little, and never raise your voice, because you don't need to. Your standards are high, your circle is small, and your sense of self is unshakeable. You're Ninetales: elegant, long-memoried, and not to be crossed.

pokemon.title: The Unstoppable Performer
pokemon.why: Anime: sings for any audience, then scribbles on everyone who falls asleep; Pokedex (RBY, Sw): keeps singing until its audience is asleep and is furious when it fails to charm.
pokemon.blurb: You need an audience, and you'll make one out of whoever's nearby. You're a performer first and a planner never, and when the room doesn't respond the way it should, you take it very personally. But you bounce back fast and you're already on to the next show. You're Jigglypuff: all heart, all volume, and absolutely unstoppable.

pokemon.title: The Scheming Charmer
pokemon.why: Anime: Team Rocket's Meowth taught itself to talk for love and schemes for status; Pokedex (RBY, LGPE): loves shiny coins, wanders the city at night and collects what catches its eye.
pokemon.blurb: You've always got a plan, and it's usually a bit of a scheme. You're clever, talkative, and a great deal more sentimental than you let on; most of your schemes are secretly about being seen. You don't do boring work, but you'll work incredibly hard at being charming. You're Meowth: the talker, the dreamer, and the one who learned the hard way and kept going anyway.

pokemon.title: The Vain Aristocrat
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): vicious, proud and fickle, it will scratch even its own trainer and is hard to raise; anime: Giovanni's lap cat, favoured and feared.
pokemon.blurb: You are nobody's pet. You're elegant, hard to impress, and not interested in pretending otherwise; people have to earn your attention and most won't. You like comfort and you like status, and you'll quietly make sure you get both. You're Persian: sleek, self-possessed, and perfectly happy with a small circle of the right people.

pokemon.title: The Walking Headache
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, SV): a constant headache leaves it dazed, and only when the pain peaks does its hidden power erupt; anime: Misty's Psyduck, bewildered and accidentally devastating.
pokemon.blurb: You carry a lot in your head and most of it is noise. You're confused more often than you'd like, worried more often than you'd admit, and far more capable than anyone (including you) expects. When it all finally comes to a head, you're astonishing. You're Psyduck: anxious, lovable, and secretly the most powerful one in the room.

pokemon.title: The Rage Engine
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): flies into a rage if you so much as look at it and chases you even when you run; its anger only grows; anime: Ash's Primeape becomes a boxing champion.
pokemon.blurb: You have a temper and everyone knows it. You run hot, you hold onto a grievance longer than is healthy, and you'd chase a slight to the ends of the earth. But that same fire makes you a relentless competitor and a loyal friend to anyone who learns not to flinch. You're Primeape: furious, driven, and secretly a champion.

pokemon.title: The Devoted Guard
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): extremely loyal, barks at anything it doesn't know, and never forgets a kind trainer; anime: Officer Jenny's partner on every beat.
pokemon.blurb: You've picked your people and you'd do anything for them. You don't need novelty or a big stage, just a job that matters and someone worth doing it for. Strangers get a wary look; friends get your whole heart. You're Growlithe: brave, dependable, and loyal to the bone.

pokemon.title: The Legendary Protector
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): a legendary beast admired for its majesty, loyal and fast enough to cover 6,200 miles in a day; anime: Arcanine often appears as a noble steed or guardian.
pokemon.blurb: You carry yourself like someone who has already proven it. You're capable and composed, you move fast when it matters, and people feel safer with you around. You don't go looking for fights, but you'll finish one for someone you love. You're Arcanine: majestic, loyal, and quietly legendary.

pokemon.title: The Grandmaster
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): an IQ of 5,000 and total recall of everything it has ever experienced; it prefers to win with its mind rather than its body.
pokemon.blurb: You've already thought three moves ahead and you're mildly annoyed everyone else hasn't. You love ideas for their own sake and you work on them with a discipline most people reserve for emergencies. You're not cold, just efficient, and your loyalty goes to the few who can keep up. You're Alakazam: brilliant, composed, and never caught off guard.

pokemon.title: The Honest Powerhouse
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): four arms that can throw 1,000 punches in two seconds, yet it fumbles delicate work; anime: a wrestler through and through.
pokemon.blurb: You do the work, and then you do more of it. You believe in showing up, lifting the heavy thing, and earning your wins honestly, and you have little patience for anyone who takes shortcuts. Delicate tasks and vague ideas frustrate you; a clear goal and a worthy rival light you up. You're Machamp: strong, straightforward, and all muscle, including the heart.

pokemon.title: The Unbothered
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, SV): takes five seconds to feel pain and forgets what it was doing mid-yawn; anime: every Slowpoke appears unbothered by anything happening to it.
pokemon.blurb: Nothing gets to you. Deadlines, drama, a Shellder clamped to your tail: you'll get round to it, or you won't, and either way you'll be fine. People find your calm contagious, and you'd never dream of competing with anyone for anything. You're Slowpoke: serene, kind, and living proof that most problems solve themselves if you wait long enough.

pokemon.title: The Grinning Prankster
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): hides in your shadow, steals your warmth, and laughs at the fright it causes; anime: grins at its own pranks; Mystery Dungeon: the cheerful villain who turns out to be lonely.
pokemon.blurb: You're the funniest person in the room and the most dangerous one to turn your back on. You love a prank, you love a reaction, and you find rules mostly decorative. Underneath the grin is someone who wants to be let in and would rather joke than ask. You're Gengar: mischievous, magnetic, and never, ever boring.

pokemon.title: The Grieving Loner
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): wears the skull of its dead mother and cries mournfully on the night of the full moon; it has never shown its face to anyone.
pokemon.blurb: You carry something heavy, and you carry it alone. You're quieter than people expect and more sensitive than you show, and you've built a hard shell around a very soft centre. You keep going because that's what you were taught, and you fight harder than anyone for what little you have. You're Cubone: grieving, brave, and more than your loss.

pokemon.title: The Caregiver
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): shares its nutritious eggs with the injured and is the Pokemon Center nurse's partner everywhere; a kind-hearted species that brings happiness to anyone who catches it.
pokemon.blurb: You're the one with the bandages, the snacks, and the time. Caring for people isn't a role you play, it's just how you move through the world, and you'd give away your last egg without thinking about it. You don't care about winning; you care about everyone making it home. You're Chansey: generous, steady, and the reason other people get to be brave.

pokemon.title: The Fierce Parent
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): raises its young in its pouch and attacks anyone who comes near, no matter the cost; anime: Kangaskhan herds in the Safari Zone defend their calves to the last.
pokemon.blurb: You're gentle with your own and terrifying to anyone who threatens them. You're responsible, grounded, and not much interested in novelty; you've got people to look after. You don't go looking for a fight, but you'll end one in seconds if it comes near your family. You're Kangaskhan: protective, practical, and fierce in all the right ways.

pokemon.title: The Showman
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): a pantomime master whose invisible walls become real if you don't laugh; anime: Delia's Mimey keeps house with impeccable discipline.
pokemon.blurb: You're a performer with a work ethic. You love to make people laugh and you take the craft of it surprisingly seriously, rehearsing the bit until the walls you build feel real. You can be a little particular about how things are done, but it's because you care. You're Mr. Mime: expressive, disciplined, and impossible to ignore.

pokemon.title: The Honour-Bound Blade
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, SV): slices with ninja speed and never lets its blades dull; anime: Tracey's Scyther was a proud former swarm leader who fought for its honour.
pokemon.blurb: You hold yourself to a code and you keep your edge sharp. You'd rather earn something the hard way than be handed it, and you have no patience for people who cheat or coast. You're not unfriendly, but you keep your circle small and your standards high. You're Scyther: precise, proud, and always ready.

pokemon.title: The Rampant Bull
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): whips itself with its three tails to work into a charge and smashes whatever is in front of it; anime: Ash catches an entire herd of them in the Safari Zone.
pokemon.blurb: You charge first and ask later. You're competitive to the core, quick to anger, and quick to forget why you were angry; you just want to be moving. Subtlety isn't your thing and you're fine with that. You're Tauros: all momentum, and a surprisingly good friend once you've stopped running.

pokemon.title: The Underdog
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): pathetically weak but able to survive in any water, splashing on no matter how many times it is mocked; the single most famous late bloomer in the series.
pokemon.blurb: People have underestimated you your whole life, and you've kept going anyway. You're not flashy and you're not fast, but you're almost impossible to discourage, and you turn up again the next day without fail. The ones who laughed will be very quiet later. You're Magikarp, and anyone who knows the story knows what comes next.

pokemon.title: The Rampage
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): the brutal transformation leaves it in a violent rage that can level a city; it is famed for flying into a frenzy at the smallest thing.
pokemon.blurb: You went through something that changed you, and you came out the other side with teeth. Your temper is legendary, your drive is enormous, and when you decide to win there is very little anyone can do about it. Calm doesn't come naturally, but the people who've seen you protect someone know the fury isn't the whole story. You're Gyarados: ferocious, formidable, and forged by what you survived.

pokemon.title: The Gentle Ferry
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): understands human speech, ferries people across the sea, and sings mournfully for its hunted kind; anime: carries Ash across the Orange Islands.
pokemon.blurb: You carry people. Sometimes literally, mostly emotionally: you're the calm voice on the long crossing and you'd never leave anyone behind. You're thoughtful and a little melancholy, with a deep memory and a deeper patience. Competition baffles you; kindness is simply the obvious choice. You're Lapras: gentle, wise, and the safest harbour your friends have.

pokemon.title: The Shapeshifter
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): rearranges its cells to become anything it sees, though it slips up when it laughs; a creature of pure adaptability with no fixed form.
pokemon.blurb: You can be whoever the moment needs, and you enjoy the trick of it. New people, new places, new ideas: you absorb them all without losing the real you underneath. Routine and rigid plans don't suit you, and you'd rather blend in and watch than compete for the spotlight. You're Ditto: adaptable, curious, and secretly the most original one here.

pokemon.title: The Open Door
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): unstable genetics let it evolve to suit its environment, so it may be the Pokemon of possibility itself; anime: Chloe's Eevee that just can't decide.
pokemon.blurb: You haven't decided what you're going to be yet, and that's your superpower. You're curious about everything, easy to love, and you light up around new possibilities more than fixed plans. Some people call that indecisive; you call it keeping the door open. You're Eevee: all potential, and every path is still yours.

pokemon.title: The Calm Current
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): melts into water and lives quietly by clear lakes, its cells so like water that it can vanish into it; the serene eeveelution.
pokemon.blurb: You go with the flow because you are the flow. People find you soothing to be around: you don't push, you don't panic, and you're perfectly content on your own by the water. You're quietly adaptable and you let most drama wash straight past you. You're Vaporeon: calm, graceful, and deeper than you first appear.

pokemon.title: The Live Wire
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): sensitive and quick to change mood, its fur stands on end and fires needles when it is startled or upset; the eeveelution with a short fuse and a big heart.
pokemon.blurb: You feel everything at full voltage. You're quick, funny, and a little prickly, and anyone who startles you will know about it immediately. You're loyal in your own electric way, but you need room to run and you don't love being told what to do. You're Jolteon: fast, intense, and never on standby.

pokemon.title: The Warm Hearth
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): stores fire in its body and fluffs its fur to release heat, running hot when excited; a loyal, cosy eeveelution that loves to be close to its trainer.
pokemon.blurb: You run warm. You're affectionate and a bit fiery, quick to get excited and quick to get your feelings hurt, and you'd always rather be near your people than off on your own. You don't overthink: you act, then you feel it. You're Flareon: cosy, loyal, and a comfort to be around.

pokemon.title: The Ancient Tyrant
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): a ferocious ancient predator with saw-like fangs that ruled the skies and shrieks as it dives; revived from amber and still wild.
pokemon.blurb: You're from another era and you've never quite fit this one. You're fierce, independent, and a little impatient with modern niceties; you'd rather take what's yours than wait to be offered it. People find you intimidating and you don't mind. You're Aerodactyl: untamed, ambitious, and ruler of your own sky.

pokemon.title: The Great Napper
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): eats 900 pounds a day and sleeps the rest, so gentle that children bounce on its belly; anime: Ash's Snorlax wakes only for food and the occasional heroic moment.
pokemon.blurb: You've figured out what matters: food, rest, and not being bothered. Nothing rattles you, nobody can rush you, and you're kinder than people expect once they stop trying to wake you up. When something truly matters you can move mountains, briefly, before going back to sleep. You're Snorlax: peaceful, immovable, and beloved.

pokemon.title: The Kind Giant
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): a kind-hearted Pokemon that rescues shipwrecked sailors and guides ships to shore; anime: Ash's Dragonite hugs first and asks questions later.
pokemon.blurb: You're big-hearted in the most literal way: people instinctively know you'd carry them to shore. You're strong and capable, and you'd rather use that to help than to win. You take your responsibilities seriously but you're never heavy about it; you lead with warmth. You're Dragonite: gentle, mighty, and everybody's safe place.

pokemon.title: The Lone Experiment
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): created by gene splicing to be the strongest, with a savage heart and no interest in anything but defeating its foes; the first movie: a being asking what it is for.
pokemon.blurb: You weren't made for this world and you've stopped apologising for it. You're intensely driven, intensely private, and you'd rather answer to no one than be anyone's project. Trust comes very slowly, and when you finally let someone in it changes everything. You're Mewtwo: powerful, solitary, and still deciding what your strength is for.

pokemon.title: The Playful Origin
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RBY, Sw): said to contain the genetic code of every Pokemon, it turns invisible and only appears to the pure of heart; Mystery Dungeon and the movies: playful, curious, mischievous.
pokemon.blurb: You find everything fascinating and you refuse to be pinned down. You're playful, warm, and endlessly curious, drifting between interests and people with a lightness that some mistake for not caring. You care enormously; you just don't do it on anyone's schedule. You're Mew: joyful, elusive, and a bit of everything.

pokemon.title: The Sunlit Sweetheart
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, HGSS): the leaf gives off a soothing aroma and it loves to sunbathe; anime: Ash's Chikorita is affectionate, jealous of Pikachu, and brave for its size.
pokemon.blurb: You lead with affection. You want to be close to the people you love and you'll quietly compete for their attention, but you'd never hurt anyone to get it. You're brighter and braver than your size suggests, and you make the room smell like springtime. You're Chikorita: sweet, loyal, and a little possessive in the most endearing way.

pokemon.title: The Shy Blaze
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, HGSS): timid, it curls into a ball when startled, but the flames on its back flare fiercely when it's angry; anime: Ash's Cyndaquil struggles to light its flame until it matters.
pokemon.blurb: You keep your fire banked. Most of the time you're gentle, a bit nervous, and happier curled up than in the spotlight, and people sometimes mistake that for weakness. Then something matters and you blaze. You're Cyndaquil: quiet, kind, and far hotter than anyone expects.

pokemon.title: The Playful Chomper
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, HGSS): playful but with a bite that can crush anything, it chomps whatever moves; anime: Ash's Totodile dances its way into every situation.
pokemon.blurb: You bite first and dance second. You're loud, fun, and impossible to keep still, and you love the world so much you want to put the whole thing in your mouth. You don't plan; you leap. You're Totodile: playful, fearless, and the life of every party you wander into.

pokemon.title: The Lucky Charm
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): its shell is filled with happiness it shares with kind people, and it is said to bring good luck; anime: Misty's Togepi, loved by everyone and secretly powerful.
pokemon.blurb: Good things happen around you, and people notice. You're warm, trusting, and generous with your joy, and you'd rather be carried along by friends than compete with them. You're more capable than anyone realises, including you. You're Togepi: a walking good omen, and the one everyone wants on their team.

pokemon.title: The Silent Oracle
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): stands motionless all day staring at the sun, seeing the past and the future, too fearful of what it sees to move; the stoic mystic.
pokemon.blurb: You see further than most and you say less. You're deeply thoughtful, oddly still, and content to watch while everyone else rushes around. People find you mysterious and you find them loud. You're Xatu: wise, patient, and keeping some of what you know to yourself.

pokemon.title: The Lighthouse
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): its tail light is bright enough to be seen from space and has been used as a lighthouse to guide ships; anime: the Olivine lighthouse Ampharos.
pokemon.blurb: You're the light people steer by. You're warm, dependable, and a bit of a beacon in a crisis: you don't shout, you just shine where you're needed. You don't need to win anything; you need everyone to get home. You're Ampharos: bright, steady, and quietly essential.

pokemon.title: The Imposter Tree
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): disguises itself as a tree to avoid attention and panics at water, with the stubborn roadblock role in every Johto journey.
pokemon.blurb: You'd rather blend in than be noticed, and you'll commit to the bit for years. You're stubborn, a little anxious, and perfectly happy standing in one spot while the world walks past. Water, change, and surprises are not your friends. You're Sudowoodo: steadfast, oddly charming, and not fooling anyone, which is fine.

pokemon.title: The Easygoing One
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): so easygoing that it bumps its head on boats and rocks while swimming and doesn't seem to mind; the carefree species.
pokemon.blurb: You are the most relaxed person anyone has ever met. Things bump into you and you keep swimming, and you've never once worried about a plan because you've never once had one. You're kind without effort and calm without trying. You're Quagsire: unhurried, unbothered, and wonderful to be around.

pokemon.title: The Devoted Seer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): extremely loyal to its trainer, it reads air currents to predict the weather and the enemy's next move so it can protect them; the eeveelution of the daytime bond.
pokemon.blurb: You see things coming before anyone else does, and you use it to look after your people. You're calm, perceptive, and disciplined, with an elegance that sometimes reads as distance. It isn't; you're just watching. You're Espeon: insightful, devoted, and always one step ahead.

pokemon.title: The Night Watcher
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): lies in wait patiently in the dark and its rings glow when it is agitated; Mystery Dungeon and fan consensus: the lone-wolf eeveelution.
pokemon.blurb: You do your best work after dark and on your own. You're patient, watchful, and unbothered by most things, and you don't need company to feel complete. People who earn your trust get a quiet, fierce loyalty that never shows off. You're Umbreon: cool, self-contained, and glowing when it counts.

pokemon.title: The Shiny-Things Thief
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): steals shiny objects, leads travellers astray at night, and is said to bring bad luck; a cheeky night bird that answers to no one.
pokemon.blurb: You're drawn to shiny things and bad ideas, and you have excellent taste in both. You're sociable, mischievous, and a little chaotic, and you'd rather be interesting than reliable. You don't mean any harm; you just can't resist. You're Murkrow: clever, cheeky, and never where you're supposed to be.

pokemon.title: The Scare Artist
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): screams and sobs at night to scare people, feeding on their fear and loving every minute; a mischief-maker rather than a menace.
pokemon.blurb: You love a reaction. You're playful in a slightly unsettling way, imaginative, and a bit of a night owl, and you find most people's fears more funny than serious. You don't want to hurt anyone; you just want to see them jump. You're Misdreavus: spooky, spirited, and secretly very good company.

pokemon.title: The Patient Wall
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): never attacks first, hates to be alone, and keeps its tail hidden; anime: Team Rocket's Wobbuffet, cheerfully popping out at the worst moment.
pokemon.blurb: You don't start things, but you absolutely finish them. You're tolerant to a fault, loyal to whoever you've ended up with, and more resilient than the people who underestimate you. You hate being alone and you don't mind saying so. You're Wobbuffet: patient, dependable, and the wall nobody gets past.

pokemon.title: The Timid Toughie
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): looks fearsome but is actually timid, biting only when it is startled; a gentle creature behind a scary face.
pokemon.blurb: People read you wrong at first. You look tougher than you feel, and you've got a soft, slightly anxious heart behind a face that scares off strangers. You bite only when cornered, and you feel awful about it afterwards. You're Granbull: misunderstood, loyal, and a big softie.

pokemon.title: The Steel Discipline
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): raises its eyespot pincers to intimidate, and trains its body to a martial precision; the species of hard metal and harder focus.
pokemon.blurb: You're disciplined to the point of intimidation. You train, you prepare, you execute, and you don't understand people who do things halfway. Warmth isn't your first language, but reliability is, and your people know they can count on you completely. You're Scizor: precise, formidable, and built for the win.

pokemon.title: The Hermit
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): hides under rocks and ferments berries inside its shell, patiently, for years; the most content recluse in the Pokedex.
pokemon.blurb: You're happiest left alone with a project and a long timeline. You're patient, private, and quietly productive, and you've never understood the appeal of a crowd. Nobody can rush you, and nothing gets through your shell. You're Shuckle: self-sufficient, kind, and working on something good.

pokemon.title: The Gentle Strongman
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): gentle and docile, it loves sweet sap, yet it can hurl a foe with a hundred times its weight using its horn; anime: Ash's sap-loving Heracross.
pokemon.blurb: You're the strongest person in the room and the least likely to mention it. You work hard, you keep your word, and you're happiest with something sweet and a sunny afternoon. But you don't lose: if someone wants a contest, you'll flip them over the horizon and then offer them a snack. You're Heracross: humble, powerful, and good-natured.

pokemon.title: The Cunning Thief
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): steals eggs from nests and uses its claws with cruel cunning; Mystery Dungeon: the thief who betrays and bargains.
pokemon.blurb: You're quick, sharp, and a little bit ruthless. You look out for yourself first, you can charm when it suits you, and you're not above a bit of mischief to get ahead. You don't trust easily, and you expect the same. You're Sneasel: clever, independent, and always one move ahead of the rules.

pokemon.title: The Generous Rescuer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): carries food in its tail and shares it with lost travellers, once rescuing a famous mountaineer with it; the species that gives.
pokemon.blurb: You turn up with something to share. You're generous, cheerful, and brave in the most practical way: you'll climb the mountain because someone up there needs you. You don't keep score and you don't compete. You're Delibird: giving, warm, and exactly who you'd want to find on a cold night.

pokemon.title: The Pack Hunter
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): its eerie howl chills, and packs are led by the one with the most curved horns; the burns it leaves never heal.
pokemon.blurb: You run with a pack, and you'd like to be leading it. You're intense, strategic, and a little frightening when you're focused, and you don't waste energy on people outside your circle. You hold grudges and you hold loyalties with equal strength. You're Houndoom: fierce, sharp, and unforgettable.

pokemon.title: The Free Artist
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): paints its own mark with its tail, with over 5,000 unique marks on record, wandering and copying whatever it sees; the artist who learns anything once.
pokemon.blurb: You make things, and that's the whole plan. You're curious about everything and loyal to nothing but the next idea, and you'd rather leave your mark on a wall than win a prize. Schedules slide off you; inspiration doesn't. You're Smeargle: original, wandering, and never finished.

pokemon.title: The Clear Wind
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): races across the land purifying water as it goes, with the grace of the north wind; it travels alone and is seldom seen.
pokemon.blurb: You move through the world leaving it cleaner than you found it. You're graceful, principled, and private, and you don't stay anywhere long enough to be caught. People are drawn to you precisely because you don't need them to be. You're Suicune: serene, elegant, and free.

pokemon.title: The Walking Earthquake
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): so insolent and powerful that it topples mountains and reshapes maps just by moving; it seeks out opponents and nothing stops it.
pokemon.blurb: You don't go around obstacles; you go through them. You're dominant, direct, and perfectly comfortable being the biggest force in the room, and you'd rather be respected than liked. Change bores you, challenge excites you. You're Tyranitar: unstoppable, uncompromising, and a landscape-altering presence.

pokemon.title: The Guardian Below
pokemon.why: Pokedex (GSC, Sw): so powerful that a flap of its wings can level houses, so it hides in the deep sea to harm no one; Pokemon 2000: the guardian of the seas' balance.
pokemon.blurb: You're far more powerful than you let on, and you keep it quiet on purpose. You're calm, principled, and protective, and you'd rather withdraw than risk hurting anyone. You surface when the balance needs restoring and vanish when it's done. You're Lugia: deep, gentle, and immensely strong.

pokemon.title: The Cool Head
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, ORAS): calm and composed, it never panics no matter the situation; anime: Ash's Treecko, the twig-chewing loner who fought for its tree.
pokemon.blurb: You don't panic, and people notice that about you first. You're cool, self-reliant, and a little hard to read, and you'd rather handle something quietly than make a scene about it. You pick your battles with care and then you don't lose them. You're Treecko: composed, capable, and perfectly fine on your own.

pokemon.title: The Burning Fighter
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): its flames burn hotter the stronger its opponent, and it clears a 30-storey building in one leap; anime: May's Blaziken, fair and fierce.
pokemon.blurb: You get better when it gets harder. Pressure doesn't shrink you, it ignites you, and you'd rather face the strongest opponent in the building than coast past the weakest. You train with discipline and fight with heart, and you believe in winning the right way. You're Blaziken: fiery, honourable, and built for the big moment.

pokemon.title: The Steady Helper
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, ORAS): senses with its fin, swims through mud, and can lift boulders when it needs to; anime: Brock's Mudkip looks after the other Pokemon; Mystery Dungeon starter: Hardy/Relaxed.
pokemon.blurb: You're the one who checks on everyone. You're friendly, grounded, and stronger than you look, and you'd rather help than compete. You don't need a stage; you need a job that matters and a group that feels like home. You're Mudkip: steady, sweet, and a lot tougher than the memes let on.

pokemon.title: The Carnival Dancer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): hears festive music and its body fills with energy, dancing uncontrollably; anime: Brock's Ludicolo, always ready to party.
pokemon.blurb: When the music starts, you're already dancing. You're the most upbeat person anyone knows, warm and generous and utterly unbothered by looking silly. You don't compete and you don't plan; you celebrate. You're Ludicolo: the party itself, and everyone's glad you came.

pokemon.title: The Guardian Heart
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): can see the future and will create a small black hole to protect its trainer, giving up its own life if it has to; Mystery Dungeon: the Pokemon who sacrificed itself.
pokemon.blurb: You'd move the universe for the people you love, and they know it. You're intuitive and gentle, with an inner strength that only shows when someone you care about is in danger. Winning doesn't interest you; protecting does. You're Gardevoir: devoted, perceptive, and far more powerful than your calm suggests.

pokemon.title: The Lazy King
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): the laziest Pokemon, lying around all day and eating only what it can reach, yet it is also one of the strongest; the lord of lazy.
pokemon.blurb: You're extremely good at doing nothing, and you're secretly extremely good at everything else too. You conserve your energy, ignore the urgency other people invent, and then move once, decisively, when it actually matters. Ambition and routine both bore you. You're Slaking: lazy, powerful, and entirely at peace with it.

pokemon.title: The Chaser
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): chases anything that moves, including its own tail, until it gets dizzy; an adorable bundle of distraction.
pokemon.blurb: You're easily delighted and easily distracted, and both are part of your charm. You're warm, playful, and quick to make friends, and you'll follow something shiny straight off the path and have a great time doing it. Plans are optional; fun isn't. You're Skitty: sweet, chaotic, and impossible to be grumpy around.

pokemon.title: The Gem Goblin
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): lurks in caves eating gems, feared for stealing spirits with its glittering eyes; a sneaky loner that loves what sparkles.
pokemon.blurb: You've got your own little cave and your own little treasures, and you don't need anyone's approval for either. You're sly, a bit odd, and delightfully self-sufficient, and the people who get you really get you. You'd rather be strange than ordinary. You're Sableye: quirky, independent, and quietly glittering.

pokemon.title: The Sweet Deceiver
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): a docile face and gentle act that lures foes into reach of its steel jaws; the deceiver.
pokemon.blurb: People underestimate you, and you let them. You're clever, a little theatrical, and perfectly capable of playing sweet until the moment you don't need to anymore. You enjoy the game and you don't feel bad about winning it. You're Mawile: charming, cunning, and full of surprises.

pokemon.title: The Territorial Guardian
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): claims a whole mountain as its territory and restores it after disasters, planting trees and carrying soil; it fiercely attacks any intruder.
pokemon.blurb: You've got your territory and you take care of it. You're responsible and a bit prickly, you don't love change, and you'd defend what's yours against anyone. Underneath the armour is someone who plants trees after the storm. You're Aggron: stubborn, steadfast, and a guardian to the core.

pokemon.title: The Bully of the Seas
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): nicknamed the bully of the sea, it attacks ships at 75 miles an hour and its fangs regrow instantly; feared by everything in the water.
pokemon.blurb: You hit hard and you don't apologise for it. You're competitive, blunt, and fast, and you have a reputation that precedes you into every room. You don't need to be liked; you need to be first. You're Sharpedo: ruthless, relentless, and the reason people check the water.

pokemon.title: The Steady Furnace
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): digs for coal in the mountains and burns it steadily, always keeping its fire going; anime: Ash's Torkoal, weeping with every emotion.
pokemon.blurb: You keep your fire going no matter what. You're slow, steady, and diligent, more interested in doing something properly than doing it fast, and you're moved to tears by things other people shrug at. Loud rooms aren't for you; long projects are. You're Torkoal: warm, reliable, and built to last.

pokemon.title: The Desert Spirit
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): its wings sing in the sandstorms it stirs up, so it's called the spirit of the desert; a roaming, free-spirited dragon.
pokemon.blurb: You're a free spirit with a surprisingly kind heart. You love wide spaces and new horizons, you make music out of chaos, and you're far more likely to wander off than settle down. People miss you when you go, and you always come back eventually. You're Flygon: roaming, warm, and impossible to fence in.

pokemon.title: The Cloud Singer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): hums in a beautiful soprano and hugs people softly with its cloud-like wings; it sings to those it loves.
pokemon.blurb: You float above the drama. You're gentle, artistic, and a soothing presence: people feel calmer within a few minutes of talking to you. You'd rather sing than argue, and you give the best hugs anyone has ever had. You're Altaria: soft, serene, and secretly a dragon.

pokemon.title: The Feud Keeper
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): locked in an ancient feud with Seviper, it is always on alert and its fur stands on end at the sight of one; it fights with the claws out.
pokemon.blurb: You've got a rival, and you take it personally. You're alert, fierce, and ready at all times, and a grudge for you isn't bitterness, it's fuel. You're loyal to a few and suspicious of most. You're Zangoose: sharp, quick, and never caught napping.

pokemon.title: The Calming Beauty
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): the most beautiful Pokemon, said to calm angry feelings and end wars just by appearing; it lives at the bottom of clear lakes.
pokemon.blurb: You bring the temperature down. You're graceful and calm, and people stop arguing when you walk in, not because you ask them to but because it suddenly seems silly. You've been through worse than they know and it made you kinder. You're Milotic: elegant, peaceful, and proof that beauty is what you do with your past.

pokemon.title: The Shopkeeper
pokemon.why: Mystery Dungeon: runs the shops in every town and is terrifyingly strong if you steal from it; Pokedex (RSE, Sw): changes colour to blend in and watch quietly.
pokemon.blurb: You run a tight ship. You're organised, observant, and friendly in a transactional sort of way, and you blend in until someone breaks the rules, at which point you're a nightmare. You respect fairness above everything. You're Kecleon: adaptable, dependable, and not to be stolen from.

pokemon.title: The Grudge Doll
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): a thrown-away plush doll brought to life by a grudge, it wanders looking for the child who abandoned it; it curses by sticking pins in itself.
pokemon.blurb: You remember who threw you away. You're intense and a little bitter, with a creative streak and a long memory, and you'd rather be feared than overlooked again. There's a soft toy somewhere under all that. You're Banette: haunted, sharp, and determined to be seen.

pokemon.title: The Misread Omen
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): senses disasters and comes down from the mountains to warn people, who blame it for the calamity instead; it lives alone as a result.
pokemon.blurb: You see the storm coming and you say so, even when nobody thanks you for it. You're thoughtful, principled, and deeply solitary, and you've made peace with being misunderstood. You'd still warn them next time. You're Absol: wise, lonely, and better than the reputation.

pokemon.title: The Hopeless Romantic
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): swims in pairs and is said to bring eternal love to couples who meet it; it lives for affection.
pokemon.blurb: You love love. You're warm, affectionate, and happiest when you've got someone to swim alongside, and you believe in the kind of devotion other people roll their eyes at. Ambition and plans come second to the people in your life. You're Luvdisc: sweet, open-hearted, and a little bit magic.

pokemon.title: The Dream That Rages
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): the dream of flying was so strong it grew wings, and when it's enraged it flies into a frenzy that burns everything; the rampaging dream.
pokemon.blurb: You wanted something so badly you grew wings for it. You're ambitious, explosive, and absolutely not interested in patience, and when you're frustrated the whole landscape knows. You can be a lot, but nobody doubts how much you want it. You're Salamence: fierce, driven, and airborne by sheer will.

pokemon.title: The Supercomputer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): four brains linked in parallel, out-calculating a supercomputer, and it pins prey under its body with cold precision.
pokemon.blurb: You think in systems and you don't get flustered. You analyse, you plan, you execute, and you have very little patience for feelings that get in the way of the right answer. People find you intimidating; you find them inefficient. You're Metagross: brilliant, relentless, and always calculating.

pokemon.title: The Empathic Flier
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): highly intelligent, understands human speech, and is so sensitive to emotions that it feels hostility as pain; Pokemon Heroes: the playful, loyal guardian of Alto Mare.
pokemon.blurb: You feel what other people feel, sometimes before they do. You're warm, intuitive, and playful, and hostility of any kind genuinely hurts you, so you'd rather disappear than fight. You love deeply and you love for life. You're Latias: empathic, gentle, and more courageous than you think.

pokemon.title: The Sky Sovereign
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): lives alone in the ozone layer for hundreds of millions of years, descending only to end the clash of Kyogre and Groudon; the apex of independence.
pokemon.blurb: You live above it all, by choice. You're powerful, self-contained, and not interested in anyone else's drama until it threatens the balance, at which point you descend and end it. You don't need a crowd or a crown. You're Rayquaza: supreme, solitary, and only ever on your own terms.

pokemon.title: The Wish Granter
pokemon.why: Pokedex (RSE, Sw): sleeps for a thousand years and wakes to grant any wish written on its tags; the gentle dreamer of the movies.
pokemon.blurb: You want good things for people, and you mean it. You're dreamy and generous, a little sleepy, and far more interested in what could be than what is. You take a while to get going, but when you do, wishes come true. You're Jirachi: hopeful, kind, and worth the wait.

pokemon.title: The Spark of Defiance
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): its flame is fuelled by its spirit and goes out when it sleeps; anime: Paul's rejected Chimchar becomes Ash's fiercest fighter.
pokemon.blurb: Someone told you that you weren't enough, and you've been proving them wrong ever since. You're energetic, scrappy, and a little raw, with a competitive streak that comes from somewhere deep. You need the right people around you, and when you have them you're unstoppable. You're Chimchar: small, fiery, and far from finished.

pokemon.title: The Proud Penguin
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): has a strong sense of pride and hates accepting food from people, finding it hard to bond; anime: Dawn's Piplup, stubborn and proud until it isn't.
pokemon.blurb: You've got standards, and you'd rather struggle than accept help you didn't ask for. You're proud, stubborn, and a little bit dramatic, and you bond slowly but completely. People learn not to pat you on the head. You're Piplup: dignified, determined, and secretly devoted.

pokemon.title: The Fearless Flier
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): never stops attacking even when it's injured, and it will leave the flock to live alone; anime: Ash's Staraptor, all speed and pride.
pokemon.blurb: You don't quit, and you don't back down. You're proud, fast, and a bit fierce, and you'd rather fly alone than slow down for a flock that isn't keeping up. Injuries don't stop you; nothing really does. You're Staraptor: bold, relentless, and your own captain.

pokemon.title: The Humble Builder
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): nerves of steel, nothing fazes it, and it gnaws constantly to build dams; the meme that became a fan icon of humble reliability.
pokemon.blurb: Nothing fazes you, and that's a bigger deal than it sounds. You're friendly, practical, and quietly productive, and you keep building while flashier people talk about building. You don't need recognition, though you've earned more than most. You're Bidoof: humble, steady, and beloved by everyone who's paying attention.

pokemon.title: The Sharp-Eyed Sentinel
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): its eyes see through walls to find prey and lost cubs alike, and it watches over its pride; the vigilant lion.
pokemon.blurb: You see through things, including people. You're watchful, protective, and a bit intense, and you use that sharp eye to look after your own before you use it to hunt. Loyalty and dominance aren't in conflict for you; they're the same job. You're Luxray: perceptive, strong, and always on watch.

pokemon.title: The Drifting Mystery
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): made of spirits, it drifts on the wind and is said to lead children away by the hand; it squeaks when squeezed; a sweet-looking enigma.
pokemon.blurb: You drift, and you like it. You're dreamy, unusual, and a little bit eerie in a way people find oddly comforting, and you'd rather float through life than be pinned down by a plan. You're curious about everything strange. You're Drifloon: light, mysterious, and quietly unforgettable.

pokemon.title: The Mob Boss
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): leads flocks of Murkrow who do its bidding, and is known as the summoner of night; the boss of the crows.
pokemon.blurb: You run the operation. You're confident and a little intimidating, with a sharp eye for talent and a flock that does what you say. You don't do the dirty work; you decide it. You're Honchkrow: commanding, cunning, and the boss of the night.

pokemon.title: The Bound Grudge
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): 108 spirits bound to a keystone for their misdeeds, malicious and wanting out; the villain's Pokemon in two games.
pokemon.blurb: You've got a lot going on inside and not all of it gets along. You're intense, private, and a little hostile to the world by default, and you don't pretend to be nicer than you are. Your loyalty is rare and strange and real. You're Spiritomb: complicated, guarded, and never dull.

pokemon.title: The Mach Hunter
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): flies at the speed of a jet to hunt down bird Pokemon and never lets prey escape; anime: Cynthia's unbeatable Garchomp.
pokemon.blurb: You go fast and you don't miss. You're ambitious, confident, and a little scary when you're focused, and you'd rather hunt down a goal than wait for it to come to you. You respect strength and you've got plenty. You're Garchomp: apex, airborne, and always closing in.

pokemon.title: The Aura Reader
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): reads the aura of all things and knows how others feel; Lucario and the Mystery of Mew: loyal to the end, even when betrayed.
pokemon.blurb: You read people, and you hold yourself to a standard most people wouldn't attempt. You're disciplined and just, with a quiet competitiveness and a loyalty that survives being let down. You don't talk much; you don't need to. You're Lucario: focused, principled, and attuned to everyone around you.

pokemon.title: The Deadpan Trickster
pokemon.why: Anime: Brock's Croagunk, who jabs him mid-flirt every single time without changing expression; Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): makes an eerie sound with its cheeks to unsettle foes.
pokemon.blurb: You have one facial expression and it's working for you. You're dry, unflappable, and quietly strange, and you deliver your best moments with no fanfare at all. You keep the people around you honest, sometimes with a jab. You're Croagunk: deadpan, dependable, and funnier than anyone gives you credit for.

pokemon.title: The Pack Schemer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): hunts in packs of four or five, carving signs into trees to coordinate; cunning, cold and very good at it.
pokemon.blurb: You work in a crew and you run the plan. You're sharp, strategic, and a bit cold-blooded about getting results, and your friends are more like co-conspirators. You don't mind being the villain in someone else's story. You're Weavile: clever, coordinated, and dangerous by design.

pokemon.title: The Peace Bringer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): never appears where there is strife, and shares blessings with people who respect each other; the jubilee Pokemon.
pokemon.blurb: You bring peace into rooms and you won't stay in ones that don't want it. You're generous, calm, and genuinely kind, and conflict for its own sake baffles you. People feel lucky to know you, and they are. You're Togekiss: gentle, bright, and a blessing on legs.

pokemon.title: The Tranquil Leaf
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): photosynthesises and is always surrounded by clean, fresh air; the calmest eeveelution.
pokemon.blurb: You're the fresh air. You're calm and kind and happiest outdoors, and you don't need a lot of noise or people to feel full. You take care of things slowly and well. You're Leafeon: tranquil, nurturing, and good for everyone around you.

pokemon.title: The Cool Precision
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): controls its body temperature precisely, freezing the air around it into diamond dust; the elegant, distant eeveelution.
pokemon.blurb: You're precise, and you keep a little distance on purpose. You're elegant and composed, with high standards and a dry wit, and you don't warm up quickly to new people. The ones who get through find the cold was never the whole story. You're Glaceon: cool, exact, and quietly beautiful.

pokemon.title: The Knightly Protector
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): a master of courtesy and swordsmanship that fights with blades from its elbows to protect someone; chivalry in Pokemon form.
pokemon.blurb: You have a code, and you live it. You're courteous and disciplined, you stand up for people who can't, and you'd never win in a way you couldn't be proud of. You take your responsibilities seriously and your friendships seriously. You're Gallade: principled, protective, and a knight in all but name.

pokemon.title: The Beautiful Chill
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): said to be the spirit of a woman lost in the snow, it freezes travellers to decorate its home; beautiful and unsettling.
pokemon.blurb: You're beautiful in a way that makes people a little nervous. You're private and creative, with a cool exterior and a slightly eerie sense of humour, and you collect what you love with quiet intensity. You don't chase company; it finds you. You're Froslass: mysterious, elegant, and not entirely of this world.

pokemon.title: The Mischief Current
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): possesses appliances and causes mischief, loving a good prank; the Rotom Dex: chatty, curious, and everywhere at once.
pokemon.blurb: You're in everything at once and you love it. You're curious, chaotic, and funny, you bounce between interests at the speed of electricity, and you've never met a system you didn't want to poke at. Boredom is your only real enemy. You're Rotom: playful, inventive, and impossible to switch off.

pokemon.title: The Banished One
pokemon.why: Pokedex (Pt, Sw): banished to the Distortion World for its violence, it watches the real world from the other side; the outcast who keeps the balance anyway.
pokemon.blurb: You were pushed out, and you built a world of your own. You're solitary and intense, with a strong sense of what's fair and a deep suspicion of anyone who thinks they can decide it for you. You watch more than you speak. You're Giratina: exiled, formidable, and nobody's subject.

pokemon.title: The Dream Keeper
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): its feathers bring happy dreams and banish nightmares, and it is the embodiment of the crescent moon; the gentle counterpart to Darkrai.
pokemon.blurb: You look after people while they sleep, metaphorically and maybe literally. You're calm, imaginative, and generous, and you'd rather chase someone's bad dream away than win anything. You keep your own counsel but you never keep your kindness. You're Cresselia: serene, protective, and a good omen.

pokemon.title: The Misunderstood Nightmare
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): causes nightmares, but only to protect itself, and means no harm; The Rise of Darkrai: the outcast who saves the town that feared it.
pokemon.blurb: You keep your distance because it's easier than explaining. You're private, misunderstood, and far gentler than your reputation, and you've stopped trying to correct the record. The people who look past the shadow find someone worth knowing. You're Darkrai: solitary, protective, and better than they say.

pokemon.title: The Gratitude Bloom
pokemon.why: Pokedex (DPPt, Sw): blooms when it feels gratitude and purifies polluted land into fields of flowers; the movie's prickly little hero.
pokemon.blurb: You bloom around kindness, and you make things cleaner wherever you go. You're sweet and a bit sensitive, with a surprising temper when people are rude, and you believe that gratitude is the point of everything. You don't need to win; you need to grow. You're Shaymin: grateful, gentle, and good for the world.

pokemon.title: The Victory Star
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): brings victory to any trainer it befriends and shares its limitless energy; the movie's lonely, generous hero.
pokemon.blurb: You're a winner, and you want everyone around you to win too. You're bright and energetic, generous with your luck, and genuinely happier when the whole team crosses the line together. You hate being alone. You're Victini: lucky, loving, and victory in small form.

pokemon.title: The Cool Aristocrat
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): calm and collected, with its nose in the air; anime: Ash's Snivy, proud, sly, and devastating with Attract.
pokemon.blurb: You're composed, a little superior, and completely fine with that. You don't flap, you don't gush, and you win more with timing than with force. You're loyal to the people who respect you and cool to everyone else. You're Snivy: elegant, sharp, and above the fuss.

pokemon.title: The Earnest Show-Off
pokemon.why: Anime: Ash's Oshawott, who shows off, cries easily, and keeps volunteering for battles anyway; Pokedex (BW, Sw): fights with its scalchop and is a quick learner.
pokemon.blurb: You want to be picked, and you're not shy about it. You're eager and a little dramatic, with a soft heart and a tendency to volunteer for things before you've thought them through. You cry easily and you never stop trying. You're Oshawott: earnest, brave, and completely endearing.

pokemon.title: The Rescue Veteran
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): a wise, loyal rescue dog that saves people lost in snowy mountains and is trusted to raise children; the species of service.
pokemon.blurb: You're the one people trust with the things that matter most. You're wise, patient, and endlessly dependable, and you've never once wanted credit for it. You don't need adventure; you need people to look after. You're Stoutland: loyal, calm, and a hero without a cape.

pokemon.title: The Tunnel Driller
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): drills 300 feet an hour and builds vast tunnel mazes; anime: Iris's Excadrill, who refused to listen until it was ready.
pokemon.blurb: You put your head down and you dig. You're hard-working and single-minded, not much for small talk, and stubborn enough to sulk for a long time if someone lets you down. Give you a goal and get out of the way. You're Excadrill: driven, focused, and unstoppable on your own terms.

pokemon.title: The Listener
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): its feelers hear a heartbeat and tell it how someone is feeling; the Pokemon Center nurse's partner in Unova.
pokemon.blurb: You hear what people aren't saying. You're warm and attentive, you take care of everyone around you, and you'd rather be useful than noticed. Competition genuinely isn't a thing you understand. You're Audino: kind, perceptive, and the reason people feel better after talking to you.

pokemon.title: The Prankster Fluff
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): slips through gaps in houses to play pranks and leaves cotton behind as a calling card; the laughing wind.
pokemon.blurb: You're trouble in the nicest possible way. You're light, funny, and impossible to catch, and you leave a trail of small mischiefs behind you wherever the wind takes you. Plans are for other people. You're Whimsicott: playful, carefree, and gone before anyone can be annoyed.

pokemon.title: The Desert Intimidator
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): never lets prey escape once it's spotted them, with jaws that crush cars; anime: Ash's sunglasses-wearing Krookodile, a cocky bruiser.
pokemon.blurb: You lock on and you don't let go. You're confident, competitive, and a bit of a bruiser, with sunglasses-level swagger and a very short list of things you're afraid of. You respect strength and you've got plenty. You're Krookodile: bold, intimidating, and very hard to shake.

pokemon.title: The Street Crew
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): moves in groups, kicks and head-butts anything that enters its turf, and protects its family and friends fiercely.
pokemon.blurb: You've got a crew and a corner, and both are yours. You're loud, loyal, and quick to throw hands for your people, with a soft spot you'd deny under oath. You don't love rules, but you love your family. You're Scrafty: scrappy, devoted, and all heart under the hood.

pokemon.title: The Illusionist
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): creates illusions to protect its den and its companions, never showing its true form; Zoroark: Master of Illusions.
pokemon.blurb: You show people what they need to see. You're clever and creative, a bit guarded, and fiercely protective of the few you let behind the illusion. You're good at reading a room and better at controlling it. You're Zoroark: cunning, loyal, and never quite what you seem.

pokemon.title: The Neat Freak
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): obsessively tidies, using its tail as a brush and greeting friends by grooming them; the species that cannot abide a mess.
pokemon.blurb: Everything has a place and you know exactly where it is. You're tidy, friendly, and a little bit particular, and you show love by making things nicer for people. Chaos stresses you; order is your art. You're Minccino: neat, warm, and a quiet perfectionist.

pokemon.title: The Star Gazer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): reads the future in the stars and weeps when it foresees its trainer's death; a quiet, cosmic mind.
pokemon.blurb: You look up more than most. You're thoughtful and a little melancholy, drawn to big questions and long nights, and you feel the future more than you'd like. People find you serious; you find them loud. You're Gothitelle: deep, quiet, and watching the stars.

pokemon.title: The Flying Mischief
pokemon.why: Anime: Iris's Emolga, who uses Attract to get out of work and steals everyone's snacks; Pokedex (BW, Sw): glides from tree to tree discharging electricity.
pokemon.blurb: You get away with it, and everyone knows it. You're charming, lazy in a strategic way, and extremely good at making other people do the work while you take the snacks. You're fun to be around and a little dangerous to trust with the last cookie. You're Emolga: adorable, scheming, and always airborne.

pokemon.title: The Ocean Nurse
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): heals injured Pokemon by wrapping them in its healing membrane, drifting across the open sea to find them; the caring fish.
pokemon.blurb: You find the hurt ones and you take care of them. You're gentle and steady, with a healing presence and no interest in winning anything, and you drift wherever you're needed. You don't make a fuss about it. You're Alomomola: nurturing, calm, and the reason someone made it through.

pokemon.title: The Soul Lantern
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): hypnotises with its flickering flames and burns away spirits, leaving them wandering; elegant, eerie, and feared.
pokemon.blurb: You're mesmerising, and a little bit dangerous. You're creative and intense, you don't warm up to strangers, and you'd rather be fascinating than friendly. You light rooms in a way people can't look away from. You're Chandelure: elegant, haunting, and not to be taken lightly.

pokemon.title: The Gentle Axe
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): kind by nature but merciless when its territory is threatened, with tusks that cut through steel; the honourable dragon.
pokemon.blurb: You're kind right up until someone crosses a line, and then you're not. You work hard, you keep your word, and you take competition seriously without taking it personally. Your friends know you as gentle; your opponents don't. You're Haxorus: steady, honourable, and sharp when it matters.

pokemon.title: The Ancient Servant
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): built by an ancient people to protect them, it obeys its orders without fail and goes on a rampage only if its seal is removed; the loyal guardian.
pokemon.blurb: You were built to protect, and you've never questioned it. You're steady, dutiful, and quietly immense, and you'd rather serve something you believe in than lead something you don't. People underestimate how much you feel. You're Golurk: loyal, patient, and unbreakable.

pokemon.title: The Ruthless Commander
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): leads a group of Pawniard and cuts down any that fall behind; it finishes off foes without hesitation.
pokemon.blurb: You lead, and you expect to be followed. You're disciplined and decisive, with no patience for excuses and very little for sentiment, and you earned your rank by being the sharpest blade in the room. People respect you more than they like you. You're Bisharp: commanding, ruthless, and always first.

pokemon.title: The Fighter for Friends
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): fights for its friends without regard for its own safety and is called the hero of the skies; the brave bird.
pokemon.blurb: You fight for your friends and you don't count the cost. You're bold, loyal, and a bit of a show-off about it, and you'd rather be brave than careful every single time. People feel safe behind you. You're Braviary: fearless, devoted, and the hero of somebody's story.

pokemon.title: The Three-Headed Fury
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): attacks anything that moves, with three heads that share no reason; the brutal dragon that trusts no one.
pokemon.blurb: You're a lot, and you're not sorry. You're aggressive and competitive, hard to argue with and harder to calm down, and you've never seen the point of playing nice. You don't trust easily, which is wise, because you'd eat anyone who tried it. You're Hydreigon: ferocious, untamed, and all in.

pokemon.title: The Sun's Stand-In
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): when volcanic ash blotted out the sun, its fire took the sun's place and it has been worshipped since; the calm, radiant moth.
pokemon.blurb: You've been the light when the sun went out. You're warm and composed, a little reserved, and happy to be the steady glow rather than the loud flame. People look to you more than you realise. You're Volcarona: radiant, calm, and quietly revered.

pokemon.title: The Ideals
pokemon.why: Pokedex (BW, Sw): helps those who pursue their ideals and scorches the world of those who don't; the dragon of ideals opposite Reshiram's truth.
pokemon.blurb: You believe in something, and you'll fight for it. You're principled, powerful, and a bit uncompromising, and you'd rather follow an ideal than a person. You respect conviction and you despise hypocrisy. You're Zekrom: driven, electric, and true to your ideals.

pokemon.title: The Curious Nut
pokemon.why: Anime: Clemont's Chespin, cheerful, food-obsessed, and forever getting into trouble; Pokedex (XY, Sw): its shell can withstand a truck and it loves to nibble.
pokemon.blurb: You're cheerful, hungry, and curious about everything, and that combination gets you into exactly as much trouble as it sounds. You're tougher than you look and kinder than you need to be. You follow your nose. You're Chespin: good-hearted, impulsive, and great company.

pokemon.title: The Silent Ninja
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): moves with ninja speed and grace, striking before anyone sees it; anime: Ash-Greninja, the bond that becomes a form.
pokemon.blurb: You move quietly and you move fast. You're disciplined and calm, highly competitive without any need to show it, and you bond deeply with very few people. When you do, you become something else entirely. You're Greninja: silent, precise, and all in on the right partner.

pokemon.title: The Pride Leader
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): the male leads the pride and protects the cubs while the females hunt; its roar sends foes running.
pokemon.blurb: You lead, and you take the responsibility that comes with it. You're confident and protective, with a competitive streak and a strong sense of who belongs to your pride. Change isn't your favourite thing; your people are. You're Pyroar: proud, protective, and born to lead.

pokemon.title: The Trusted Mount
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): reads its rider's feelings through its horns and carries people wherever they need to go; the mount of Lumiose City.
pokemon.blurb: You're the one people climb onto when they're tired. You're calm and dependable, with a sixth sense for how someone's really doing, and you'd carry them all the way without asking for anything back. You don't compete; you carry. You're Gogoat: trustworthy, gentle, and strong in the ways that matter.

pokemon.title: The Tough Act
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): glares at foes with a leaf in its mouth to look tough, but can't help smiling when patted; the little hard-case.
pokemon.blurb: You act tough, and you're fooling almost no one. You're competitive and loud, quick to glare and quicker to grin when someone sees through it, and you want to be taken seriously more than you'd admit. You've got heart under the act. You're Pancham: scrappy, sweet, and trying very hard.

pokemon.title: The Groomed Guardian
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): guarded the king of Kalos in ancient times, is highly loyal, and only lets a trusted person groom it.
pokemon.blurb: You hold yourself to a standard, and you hold your people close. You're loyal and well put together, a bit traditional, and particular about who gets close. You take care of things properly and expect the same. You're Furfrou: elegant, devoted, and quietly aristocratic.

pokemon.title: The Blank Stare
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): suppresses enormous psychic power behind an expressionless stare, and its eyes carry a lonely look; the unsettling kitten.
pokemon.blurb: You're holding a lot in, and people can tell. You're quiet and intense, with an inner world far bigger than anything you show, and you keep your distance because closeness is complicated. The few who get past the stare find a lot there. You're Espurr: still, deep, and quietly powerful.

pokemon.title: The Hypnotic Manipulator
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): hypnotises with its flashing body and makes others do its bidding, and is said to have altered the course of history; the schemer.
pokemon.blurb: You get people to do what you want, and they thank you for it. You're clever and strategic, with a flair for persuasion and very little interest in playing fair when playing smart works better. You enjoy the long game. You're Malamar: cunning, patient, and quietly in control.

pokemon.title: The Ancient King
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): nothing could challenge it a hundred million years ago, so it ruled as a king; the despot of the fossils.
pokemon.blurb: You rule, and you've never seen a reason not to. You're confident and dominant, a bit old-fashioned, and not interested in anyone's opinion of your reign. You're generous to your subjects and fierce to your rivals. You're Tyrantrum: regal, powerful, and completely unapologetic.

pokemon.title: The Peacemaker Ribbon
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): wraps its ribbons around its trainer's arm and sends out a calming aura that ends fights; the eeveelution of affection.
pokemon.blurb: You end fights by being too lovely to fight near. You're warm and affectionate, you hold on tight to the people you love, and you'd rather soothe than win every time. People feel cared for around you because they are. You're Sylveon: sweet, soothing, and everyone's favourite.

pokemon.title: The Showboat Wrestler
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): proud of its graceful moves, it strikes a pose before every attack; anime: Ash's Hawlucha, who never skips the pose.
pokemon.blurb: You win with style or not at all. You're proud and flashy, competitive to the bone, and physically incapable of skipping the pose. You love a crowd and the crowd loves you back. You're Hawlucha: showy, fearless, and always the main event.

pokemon.title: The Whisker Messenger
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): communicates through its whiskers and steals electricity from homes to fuel its chatter; anime: Bonnie's sleepy, cheerful Dedenne.
pokemon.blurb: You're small, chatty, and adored. You keep in touch with everyone, you borrow things without quite asking, and you make friends in the time it takes other people to say hello. You nap a lot and nobody minds. You're Dedenne: friendly, cosy, and always in the loop.

pokemon.title: The Clingy Softie
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): extremely friendly, it hugs its trainer and covers them in slime; anime: Ash's Goodra, gentle giant with a tearful heart.
pokemon.blurb: You love people and you show it, maybe a little too much. You're gentle and soft-hearted, a bit clingy, and completely devoted to the people you've chosen. You'd never hurt anyone and you cry at films. You're Goodra: affectionate, loyal, and the best hugger in the region.

pokemon.title: The Key Keeper
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): collects keys and never gives them up, and was once trusted to guard the keys of noble houses; the organised hoarder.
pokemon.blurb: You keep the keys, literally and otherwise. You're organised and trustworthy, a bit of a collector, and you take safeguarding things very seriously. People hand you what matters because you never lose it. You're Klefki: reliable, meticulous, and the keeper of everyone's secrets.

pokemon.title: The Night Screamer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (XY, Sw): anything that moves in the dark is prey, and it fights with ultrasonic waves; anime: Ash's Noivern, affectionate and playful despite it all.
pokemon.blurb: You come alive at night and you fly fast. You're bold and a bit wild, playful with your friends and fierce with everyone else, and you like the dark because it's quieter. You don't ask for directions. You're Noivern: swift, sonic, and free after sundown.

pokemon.title: The Ring Trickster
pokemon.why: Pokedex (ORAS, Sw): teleports anything through its rings for the fun of it, delighting in mischief; Hoopa and the Clash of Ages: the trickster who steals the world.
pokemon.blurb: Why walk through a door when you can pull the door to you? You're mischievous and brilliant, bored by rules and thrilled by chaos, and you'd rather pull off something impossible than something sensible. Consequences are for later. You're Hoopa: playful, powerful, and a genie with a grin.

pokemon.title: The Silent Archer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): careful and cool-headed, nocking an arrow in a tenth of a second, though it can be startled into absent-mindedness; the quiet marksman.
pokemon.blurb: You're calm, careful, and lethal from a distance. You don't need noise or company to feel complete, and you'd rather take one perfect shot than ten loud ones. People think you're aloof; you're just concentrating. You're Decidueye: focused, graceful, and quietly deadly.

pokemon.title: The Aloof Loner
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): doesn't show its emotions, hates being touched, and grooms itself alone; anime: Ash's Litten, the stray who looked after an old Stoutland.
pokemon.blurb: You don't do affection on demand. You're cool and self-reliant, allergic to being fussed over, and more loyal than you'd ever admit out loud. You'd rather look after someone quietly than say anything about it. You're Litten: aloof, proud, and secretly devoted.

pokemon.title: The Heel Champion
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): a crude showman that ignores its trainer when the crowd cheers, yet protects children and the weak; the heel who's secretly a face.
pokemon.blurb: You play the villain because it's more fun, and the crowd loves you for it. You're loud, competitive, and rough around the edges, and you'd never admit how much you care about the little ones watching. You're a lot of show and more heart. You're Incineroar: the heel, the champion, and the hero in disguise.

pokemon.title: The Songstress
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): controls water balloons with its singing voice and performs with grace; each one has its own song passed down the family.
pokemon.blurb: Your voice is your power, and you use it beautifully. You're expressive and warm, a performer with real discipline behind the sparkle, and you'd rather move people than beat them. You love your people and you sing it. You're Primarina: graceful, gifted, and born for the stage.

pokemon.title: The Loyal Wolf
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): the Midday form is obedient and loyal; the Midnight form taunts foes and loves a fight; anime: Ash's Dusk Lycanroc, fierce and faithful.
pokemon.blurb: You're loyal and you're wild, and you don't see why you'd have to pick. You're fiercely competitive, quick to taunt, and quick to defend your pack, and you need a partner who can keep up. You run hot and you run hard. You're Lycanroc: devoted, fierce, and never tame.

pokemon.title: The Strength in Numbers
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): weak and teary alone, but when it schools it terrifies even Gyarados; the species that is only strong together.
pokemon.blurb: On your own, you worry; together, you're terrifying. You're a team person through and through, loyal and a little anxious, and you do your best work shoulder to shoulder with people you trust. Nobody should underestimate what happens when you all show up. You're Wishiwashi: humble, loyal, and strongest in a crowd.

pokemon.title: The Unflinching Workhorse
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): carries ten tons across rough ground for three days and nights without rest, and nothing makes it panic; the embodiment of grit.
pokemon.blurb: You just keep going. You're steady and tireless, unbothered by noise or pressure or weather, and you do the heavy work without a single complaint. Flash means nothing to you; finishing means everything. You're Mudsdale: enduring, dependable, and impossible to rattle.

pokemon.title: The Pheromone Queen
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): leads a harem of Salandit with pheromones that make others do as it pleases; the queen who runs the show.
pokemon.blurb: You run the room, and everyone knows it. You're confident and magnetic, a little ruthless, and extremely good at getting people to do what you want and enjoy it. You don't ask permission. You're Salazzle: commanding, charismatic, and in charge.

pokemon.title: The Crushing Hugger
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): its friendly hugs are strong enough to crush, so it must be approached with care; anime: Team Rocket's unbeatable, affectionate landlord.
