pokemon.blurb: You love hard, sometimes too hard. You're warm and generous and a bit overwhelming, with no idea how strong you are, and the people you've adopted have long since given up resisting. You'd do anything for them, immediately. You're Bewear: affectionate, powerful, and dangerously huggable.

pokemon.title: The Haughty Queen
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): haughty and merciless with its kicks, scornful of the weak, yet it protects every Bounsweet in its care; the queen who earns the crown.
pokemon.blurb: You have standards, and you enforce them. You're elegant and formidable, a little scornful of people who don't try, and fiercely protective of the ones who look up to you. You lead from the front and you win in heels. You're Tsareena: regal, ruthless, and secretly devoted.

pokemon.title: The Flower Healer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): picks flowers and hangs them on its vine, and the soothing scent heals the sick; it is used in Alola's hospitals.
pokemon.blurb: You make people feel better, and you do it on purpose. You're cheerful and nurturing, organised in your kindness, and completely uninterested in winning anything. You'd rather decorate someone's day. You're Comfey: healing, warm, and a joy to have around.

pokemon.title: The Forest Sage
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): sits high in the trees thinking, uses tools and gives items to Pokemon it deems worthy; people once mistook it for a human; the sage.
pokemon.blurb: You think before you act, and you think a lot. You're wise and observant, a little aloof, and generous in a careful, deliberate way: you help the ones who've earned it. You'd rather understand than compete. You're Oranguru: thoughtful, patient, and quietly profound.

pokemon.title: The Team Player
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): lives in groups of about twenty, passing berries to each other and following a leader who's chosen for its throwing; teamwork is everything.
pokemon.blurb: You're nothing without the team, and you're proud of that. You're energetic and loyal, with a strong competitive streak that only ever points outward, and you'd rather pass the ball than take the shot. You'd give anything for your squad. You're Passimian: cooperative, committed, and built for the group.

pokemon.title: The Nervous Scavenger
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): a coward that flees at the slightest sound, but it cleans the beaches of whatever it finds; the anxious little helper.
pokemon.blurb: You're scared of a lot, and you keep going anyway. You're gentle and jumpy, quick to run and quick to come back, and you do more good than you realise by just tidying up after everyone. Bravery isn't the absence of fear; it's you. You're Wimpod: nervous, kind, and more useful than you know.

pokemon.title: The Immovable
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): never leaves its spot, and if thrown back into the sea it crawls right back to where it was; the stubborn sea cucumber.
pokemon.blurb: You've found your spot and you're staying in it. You're calm and stubborn, completely unbothered by being told to move, and quietly content in a way other people find mysterious. Change isn't a threat; it's just not happening. You're Pyukumuku: immovable, serene, and perfectly fine, thanks.

pokemon.title: The Dreaming Sleeper
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): born asleep and dies asleep, living out its whole life in dreams while clutching a log; the serene sleeper.
pokemon.blurb: You're living in a dream and honestly it's going well. You're peaceful and unbothered, happy in your own head, and more or less immune to stress because you've never really woken up for it. People envy your calm. You're Komala: dreamy, serene, and holding on to your log.

pokemon.title: The Lonely Disguise
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): wears a Pikachu rag so people will love it, and cries under the disguise when it's lonely; Mystery Dungeon: the misunderstood one.
pokemon.blurb: You just want to be loved, and you've put a lot of work into the costume. You're shy and sincere, a little anxious, and far more loyal than the people who never looked under the rag deserved. Someone will see you properly. You're Mimikyu: lonely, loving, and worth the look.

pokemon.title: The Grandparent Dragon
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): gentle with children and loves to play with them, but if a child is hurt it goes on a furious rampage; the grandparent.
pokemon.blurb: You're gentle with the little ones and terrifying to anyone who hurts them. You're warm and patient, happy to tell the same story twice, and your calm hides an absolutely volcanic protective streak. You don't compete; you look after. You're Drampa: kind, wise, and not to be tested.

pokemon.title: The Clanging Honour
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): clangs its scales to intimidate before a fight and trains relentlessly, battling only those it respects; the honourable dragon.
pokemon.blurb: You announce yourself, and you back it up. You're disciplined and proud, with a strong sense of honour and a love of a fair fight, and you train harder than anyone you compete with. You respect people who respect the rules. You're Kommo-o: honourable, loud, and ready.

pokemon.title: The Fickle Guardian
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SM, Sw): curious and fickle, it loves battles and lends power on a whim, then vanishes; anime: the guardian that picks a fight with Ash for fun.
pokemon.blurb: You're curious, impulsive, and impossible to predict. You love a good fight and a good surprise, you help people when you feel like it and vanish when you don't, and you've never once explained yourself. You're a storm with a sense of humour. You're Tapu Koko: wild, playful, and entirely your own.

pokemon.title: The Stick Drummer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): beats a rhythm with its stick that makes plants grow, and is endlessly curious; anime: Goh's Grookey, who drums on everything.
pokemon.blurb: You've always got a beat going. You're upbeat and curious, a little restless, and you make things grow just by being around them. You'd rather jam than plan. You're Grookey: rhythmic, cheerful, and good for the garden.

pokemon.title: The Striker
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): juggles a pebble into a fireball and kicks it with pinpoint aim, but gets carried away showing off when the crowd cheers; the striker.
pokemon.blurb: You play to win and you play to the crowd. You're energetic and skilled, a bit of a show-off, and at your best when the stakes are high and people are watching. You've got the goal in sight before anyone else. You're Cinderace: fast, fiery, and the one who takes the shot.

pokemon.title: The Teary Chameleon
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): turns invisible in water, and its tears are so potent that everyone around starts crying too; anime: Goh's Sobble, hiding in his hood.
pokemon.blurb: You cry easily, and you make everyone else cry with you, which is a skill. You're sensitive and shy, quick to vanish when things get loud, and much braver on the inside than the outside shows. You care enormously. You're Sobble: tender, timid, and growing into something fierce.

pokemon.title: The Sky Taxi Knight
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): highly intelligent and calm, it carries people across Galar as the Flying Taxi and is the terror of the skies; the stoic knight.
pokemon.blurb: You get people where they need to go, reliably, without drama. You're calm and disciplined, with a steely sense of duty and no patience for nonsense, and you're more capable in a crisis than almost anyone. You don't need thanks. You're Corviknight: composed, dependable, and armoured all the way through.

pokemon.title: The Woolly Follower
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): follows the herd, rolls away from trouble, and hates conflict; the gentle sheep of Galar.
pokemon.blurb: You go with the group and you avoid the fuss. You're gentle and soft, happiest among your people, and when trouble starts you simply roll away from it, which is honestly a strategy. You're not here to fight. You're Wooloo: cosy, loyal, and wonderfully unbothered.

pokemon.title: The Treat-Driven Pup
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): herds livestock, chases after anything that runs, and only really moves when it's expecting a treat; the corgi.
pokemon.blurb: You're everyone's best friend, especially if they've got snacks. You're loyal and bouncy, a little food-motivated, and the kind of presence that makes a bad day better just by showing up. You'd follow your people anywhere, at a jog. You're Yamper: joyful, devoted, and extremely good.

pokemon.title: The Gulping Goof
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): swallows anything that fits in its beak and refuses to let go, even a Pikachu; a bit dim, entirely committed.
pokemon.blurb: You commit to the bit. You're a bit scatterbrained and a lot stubborn, and once you've got hold of something you're not letting go, however little sense it makes. People find you baffling and endearing in equal measure. You're Cramorant: goofy, tenacious, and never spitting it out.

pokemon.title: The Rock Star
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): strums the protrusions on its chest to make thunderous noise and stirs up a crowd; Amped Form is wild, Low Key is cooler; the punk rocker.
pokemon.blurb: You're loud on purpose. You're a performer and a rebel, bored by rules and thrilled by a crowd, and you'd rather be electric than correct. You're a bit chaotic and completely magnetic. You're Toxtricity: amped, defiant, and headlining.

pokemon.title: The Forest Witch
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): hates noise and strong emotions, and strikes down intruders with its psychic claws from its forest home; the witch who wants to be left alone.
pokemon.blurb: You need quiet, and you'll make it if you have to. You're deeply private and highly sensitive, with a rich inner world and very little patience for people who intrude on it. Loud rooms hurt. Your forest is your own. You're Hatterene: solitary, powerful, and not to be disturbed.

pokemon.title: The Punk Blocker
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): blocks, screams, and then strikes, with a voice that shakes the air; it protects its family and never backs down from a brawl.
pokemon.blurb: You stand in the way on purpose. You're loud, tough, and fiercely protective of your own, and you'd much rather meet trouble head-on than wait for it. You've got a punk heart and a family soul. You're Obstagoon: defiant, loyal, and extremely hard to get past.

pokemon.title: The Fair Knight
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): fights fair and never ambushes, and when its leek withers it retires from battle; the chivalrous knight of Galar.
pokemon.blurb: You fight fair or you don't fight. You're disciplined and honourable, old-fashioned in the best way, and you'd rather lose with dignity than win with a trick. People trust you completely and they should. You're Sirfetch'd: noble, dependable, and a knight to the end.

pokemon.title: The Formation
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): six individuals that act as one, with a brass commanding five troopers in perfect formation; the team that never breaks.
pokemon.blurb: You move as one with your people. You're disciplined and loyal, with an almost military sense of order and no interest in going it alone. You win because everyone does their part. You're Falinks: coordinated, committed, and strongest in formation.

pokemon.title: The Mind-Reading Butler
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): reads feelings with its horns and anticipates what its trainer needs, serving faithfully; the butler Pokemon.
pokemon.blurb: You know what people need before they ask. You're attentive and organised, gentle and devoted, and you take real satisfaction in a job done perfectly for someone you care about. You don't need the spotlight. You're Indeedee: thoughtful, faithful, and quietly indispensable.

pokemon.title: The Hangry Switch
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): constantly hungry, swinging between a cheerful Full Belly Mode and a furious Hangry Mode; the mood on legs.
pokemon.blurb: You're delightful until you're hungry, and then you're a different person. You run on snacks and feelings, and both change fast. People learn to keep a seed packet handy. You're Morpeko: lovable, moody, and always one meal away from chaos.

pokemon.title: The Family Missile
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): fires the Dreepy living in its horns like missiles, and the Dreepy enjoy it; outside battle it plays with them gently.
pokemon.blurb: You're fast, a little mysterious, and surprisingly family-minded. You're competitive and clever, happy to launch the people you love at their goals, and gentle with them afterwards. You see the invisible angles. You're Dragapult: swift, strategic, and secretly a parent.

pokemon.title: The Hero's Blade
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): the hero that saved Galar, it fights with a sword in its mouth and fells anything in one blow; the silent knight of legend.
pokemon.blurb: You're the one who steps forward when everyone else steps back. You're calm and formidable, with a strong moral core and no need for an audience, and you'd rather act than announce. Legends are made of people like you. You're Zacian: heroic, steadfast, and sharper than anyone expects.

pokemon.title: The Jungle Pack
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SwSh): lives in packs deep in the jungle and treats outsiders with hostility; Secrets of the Jungle: Dada Zarude raises a human child as its own.
pokemon.blurb: You protect your pack and you're wary of everyone else. You're tough and territorial, with a hidden softness for the ones you've chosen, and you'd break your own rules for them. The jungle is home. You're Zarude: fierce, protective, and loyal in your own way.

pokemon.title: The Masked Magician
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): a showy magician that dazzles with flashy tricks, then plants a seed bomb while you're watching the wrong hand; Sprigatito loves attention.
pokemon.blurb: You dazzle on purpose, and the trick is already done. You're creative and clever, a little vain, and very good at making people look where you want them to. You prefer applause to approval. You're Meowscarada: showy, sly, and a step ahead of the audience.

pokemon.title: The Laid-Back Foodie
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): laid back and does things at its own pace, with food above everything; it absorbs the heat of a good meal to power its flame.
pokemon.blurb: You've got your priorities straight: food, friends, and no rush whatsoever. You're warm and easygoing, impossible to stress, and happiest with a full plate and good company. Ambition can wait until after lunch. You're Fuecoco: relaxed, affectionate, and always hungry.

pokemon.title: The Dancing Rival
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): dances with a rhythm that makes foes want to join in, and feels an intense rivalry with anyone who dances better; the showstopper.
pokemon.blurb: You turn everything into a performance and then you win it. You're exuberant and competitive, full of rhythm and pride, and you'd rather out-dance someone than out-argue them. The crowd is your natural habitat. You're Quaquaval: flamboyant, fierce, and fabulous.

pokemon.title: The Gentle Glutton
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): timid and gentle, it hunts for fragrant herbs and will eat anything, surprising people with its speed when startled; the hog with a heart.
pokemon.blurb: You're soft, you're sweet, and you're always thinking about the next snack. You're easygoing and kind, a bit timid in a crowd, and surprisingly quick when something alarming happens. You don't need to win anything. You're Lechonk: gentle, content, and extremely lovable.

pokemon.title: The Family First
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): a family of three or four that does everything together, the little ones following their parents; the species that puts family first.
pokemon.blurb: You've got a family and that's the whole plan. You're warm and sociable, organised in a domestic sort of way, and you'd never do anything that left someone behind. Together is the only way you work. You're Maushold: close-knit, caring, and never alone.

pokemon.title: The Friendly Loaf
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): a friendly, popular puppy whose breath yeast is used in baking; it loves people and is loved back.
pokemon.blurb: You're warm, soft, and genuinely good for people. You're friendly to everyone, a bit of a people-pleaser, and happiest when the whole house smells like something baking. You don't do conflict. You're Fidough: sweet, sociable, and rising nicely.

pokemon.title: The Loyal Knight
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): wears armour inherited from the Ceruledge line and refuses to fight dirty, fighting only with honour; the loyal, disciplined knight.
pokemon.blurb: You do things properly, and you'd rather lose than cheat. You're disciplined and dutiful, calm under pressure, and loyal to the people and principles you've chosen. You don't need to be loud to be strong. You're Armarouge: honourable, steady, and armoured in integrity.

pokemon.title: The Ghostly Swordsman
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): fights with blades of fire and bitter regret, moving with a swordsman's grace and showing mercy to no one; the dark mirror of Armarouge.
pokemon.blurb: You carry something old and you fight with it. You're disciplined and solitary, driven by a grudge you've turned into a craft, and you'd rather be respected than understood. Your blade is steady. You're Ceruledge: haunted, precise, and merciless.

pokemon.title: The Big Softie
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): looks fierce but is devoted to its family and gentle with children; anime and games: Arven's Mabosstiff, the heart of the Paldea story.
pokemon.blurb: You look intimidating and you're actually the gentlest person anyone knows. You're loyal and steady, with a tough exterior and a soft, family-first heart, and you'd stand between your people and anything. You don't need to prove it. You're Mabosstiff: protective, devoted, and a big softie.

pokemon.title: The Hammer Hunter
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): builds a hammer from scrap metal and hunts Corviknight with it, knocking them out of the sky for fun; the small, dangerous crafter.
pokemon.blurb: You built your own hammer and you know how to use it. You're crafty and competitive, a little cheeky, and not remotely intimidated by anything bigger than you. You pick your targets and you don't miss. You're Tinkaton: resourceful, fierce, and a lot of fun at a scrapyard.

pokemon.title: The Lonely Ghost Pup
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): friendly and loyal, it follows anyone who shows it kindness, draining their life force without meaning to; the ghost dog who just wants company.
pokemon.blurb: You just want someone to stay. You're affectionate and loyal, a little lonely, and you have a way of accidentally overwhelming people with how much you care. The right person won't mind at all. You're Greavard: devoted, gentle, and waiting by the door.

pokemon.title: The Rage That Outlived Death
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): its rage was so strong it transcended death, and it now fights with an unnerving calm until the fury erupts; the ghost of Primeape's anger.
pokemon.blurb: You've been angry so long it's become a kind of calm. You're intense and driven, patient in a way that unsettles people, and when the rage comes it's absolute. You don't forgive and you don't quit. You're Annihilape: focused, furious, and beyond stopping.

pokemon.title: The Commander
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): leads an army of Bisharp and only the strongest, most ruthless Bisharp rises to become one; it wins by strategy as much as blades.
pokemon.blurb: You command, and you earned the right. You're strategic and disciplined, with a ruthless clarity about what it takes to win and no patience for anyone who can't keep up. Respect is given to you, not asked for. You're Kingambit: calculating, dominant, and at the top for a reason.

pokemon.title: The Golden Charmer
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV): a friendly, flashy body of coins that charms everyone it meets and is surprisingly hard to pin down; the golden socialite.
pokemon.blurb: You're the shiniest person at the party and you know it. You're friendly and flashy, easy to like and hard to hold onto, and you spend your charm as freely as your coins. People light up when you arrive. You're Gholdengo: golden, sociable, and never quite catchable.

pokemon.title: The Masked Outsider
pokemon.why: Pokedex (SV DLC): mischievous and lonely, it lived apart from the village that feared it and stayed loyal to the one human who loved it; the outsider with a mask.
pokemon.blurb: You've been on the outside, and it made you fiercely loyal to the few who let you in. You're playful and sensitive, a bit wary of crowds, and you hide more behind the mask than people realise. The right people see you. You're Ogerpon: misunderstood, brave, and true to your own.
